info.name: Punk API — Brewdog DIY Dog Beer Recipes Beers API

params.name: abv_gt
params.description: Return beers with an ABV strictly greater than the supplied number.

params.name: abv_lt
params.description: Return beers with an ABV strictly less than the supplied number.

params.name: ibu_gt
params.description: Return beers with an IBU (bitterness) strictly greater than the supplied number.

params.name: ibu_lt
params.description: Return beers with an IBU strictly less than the supplied number.

params.name: ebc_gt
params.description: Return beers with an EBC (colour) strictly greater than the supplied number.

params.name: ebc_lt
params.description: Return beers with an EBC strictly less than the supplied number.

params.name: beer_name
params.description: Substring match on beer name. Use underscores in place of spaces (e.g. `beer_name=punk_ipa`).

params.name: hops
params.description: Substring match on hop name. Use underscores in place of spaces (e.g. `hops=simcoe`).

params.name: malt
params.description: Substring match on malt name. Use underscores in place of spaces (e.g. `malt=maris_otter`).

params.name: yeast
params.description: Substring match on yeast strain name. Use underscores for spaces.

params.name: food
params.description: Substring match against a beer's food-pairing list. Use underscores in place of spaces (e.g. `food=spicy_food`).

params.name: brewed_before
params.description: Return beers first brewed before the supplied date. Format: `mm-yyyy` (e.g. `12-2010`).

params.name: brewed_after
params.description: Return beers first brewed after the supplied date. Format: `mm-yyyy` (e.g. `01-2015`).

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of BrewDog beer recipes. Supports a rich family of recipe-oriented query filters — ABV / IBU / EBC ranges, brewed-before/after date ranges, and substring lookups on beer name, hops, malt, yeast, and food pairing. Underscores are used in place of spaces inside multi-word filter values (e.g. `hops=simcoe` or `food=spicy_food`). Pagination uses `page` (>=1) and `per_page` (1-80, default 25).
Returns a single beer recipe by its integer id. The id range is roughly 1-325 (matching the 325 DIY Dog recipes in the dataset). Returns 404 when no beer matches the supplied id.
Returns a single random beer recipe sampled uniformly from the 325 DIY Dog entries. Useful for "beer of the day" demos and for sampling the shape of the dataset.
